hero.label: Milestone-Based Financing
hero.title: About CineX
hero.description: Making creative IP investable, verifiable, and bankable
hero.content: CineX Protocol is a milestone-based financing infrastructure for African creative IP. We connect idle capital to Africa's $5B+ creative economy — making creative projects verifiable, bankable, and investable through on-chain milestone governance and productive escrow on Stacks.

story.label: Our Story
story.title: Cypherpunk Finance for African Creatives
story.content:
CineX was built to solve a fundamental problem: African filmmakers and creative entrepreneurs lack access to the financing infrastructure that powers the global entertainment industry. Traditional finance demands collateral they don't have. Crowdfunding platforms take 10-15% fees. Neither offers milestone-based accountability.

Built on Stacks (Bitcoin L2), CineX uses milestone escrow contracts to release funds only when deliverables are verified by independent endorsers. Every contribution, milestone completion, and reputation signal is recorded on-chain — creating a transparent, trust-minimized financing layer for the $5B+ African creative economy.
